outcome: Risk factors for respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) in full-term neonates
cohort: 205 full-term neonates with RDS (study group) and 410 full-term neonates without RDS (control group) admitted to Bayi Children's Hospital between January 2008 and December 2010
finding: Several high-risk factors, such as selective cesarean section, severe birth asphyxia, maternal-fetal infection, PROM, and male sex are closely correlated with full-term neonatal RDS.
mod_finding: Selective cesarean section was found to be significantly associated with an increased risk of RDS in full-term neonates (OR: 8.737; 95% CI: 5.232-14.588).
